messages:
matt: kicked off post-deploy smoke for canary pools. Observed steady load-shedding (rate-limited 503s) on the long-prompt route in sa-east1 during warmup (approx 4-10m).
deploy-bot: Deploy complete: release/2026-03-26-canary -> canary pools. Postdeploy probes initiated (ci: 4867778888).
lina: saw ~12% of long-prompt probes get 503/limited responses. Short prompts fine. Traces show graceful_failover=true path triggering to dedicated capacity.
ops: checking edge logs: `edge-proxy-sa-east1` shows repeated `X-Flow-Control: shed` along with `inference_pool.overload` metrics up.
matt: hypothesis: new routing policy in v2026-03-26 bumps long-prompt concurrency and our flow-control kicks in. Could be a config mismatch between route.qps and pool.max_inflight.
jack: Proposal: hold global promote, pin sa-east1 to v2026-03-24, and temporarily increase dedicated fallback capacity for long-prompt route to avoid user-visible shed while we tune.
sam: Agreed. Action: pin sa-east1 and scale dedicated long-prompt pool by +2 nodes.
ops: Pin command executed:
```
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/route/pin \
  -d '{"region":"sa-east1","model_variant":"v2026-03-24"}'
```
Response: 200 OK.
deploy-bot: Routing update: sa-east1 -> v2026-03-24 (pinned). Synthetic-scheduler queued 600 long-prompt seeds.
ops: Scaled dedicated long-prompt pool +2 nodes (scale op id: scale-9421). Capacity available.
lina: After pin+scale, shed rate dropped to baseline (~0.5%). p95 for long-prompt route returned to normal.
matt: Filing runtime ticket RT-6421: "flow-control: route concurrency mismatch causes graceful-failover overload for long prompts". cc runtime@ and infra@.
jack: Next steps in runbook: 1) validate route.qps and pool.max_inflight alignment in config repo, 2) run focused canary with throttled qps to reproduce, 3) if config bug, roll hotfix; else tune autoscaling thresholds.
sam: Decision: keep sa-east1 pinned for 1 hour, keep dedicated scale while we validate. Add release note: 'sa-east1 pinned to v2026-03-24 due to long-prompt flow-control shedding during canary; dedicated fallback scaled temporarily.'
deploy-bot: Release notes updated on release record.
lina: I'll attach representative traces and shed metrics to RT-6421.
matt: If the focused canary with throttled qps passes, we'll remove the pin and revert temporary scaling. Otherwise plan a targeted canary rollback and schedule a change window to adjust autoscaling thresholds. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
